title: On the holomorphic differential operator $\frac{d}{dz}: Q_K\to L^q(WdA)$
summary: In this paper, we obtain non-testing characterizations, in terms of dyadic capacity gauges, of the boundedness and compactness of the differentiation operator $$ \frac{d}{dz}:Q_K\longrightarrow L^q(W\,dA), \qquad 0<q<\infty. $$ We also characterize the limiting case as $q\to0^+$, formulated in terms of a logarithmic geometric mean, while the endpoint $q=\infty$ is treated separately using a standard testing argument.
